race.comment: ELITE ENOUGH (11) resumes as the horse to beat, despite being unplaced in three starts, because her final run last campaign at Pinjarra was sound enough for a race like this. Faithfull riding from a good draw is a big tick and from a good draw, she can make an impression on resumption. THE STALAGMITE (9) is race fit and was respected in betting when sixth at this track behind Jewel Of Zavala, beaten just under five lengths; the 1200m record remains a query, but his recent ratings hold up well for a maiden of this depth. NAKILA (12) was long odds on debut at Northam and finished 12th, beaten five and a half lengths, yet she kept on and had three Lark Hill trials before racing, so natural improvement second-up is a genuine factor. KALLAHTI (1) has not broken through in 13 starts, but he is third-up, has placed twice at this venue and his Mingenew fourth two runs ago keeps him in the place mix. NORTHERN DIAMOND (7) is next.
